notification_outbox_status_timestamps.name: notification_outbox_status_timestamps
notification_outbox_status_timestamps.value:
("notification_outbox"."status" = 'delivered') = ("notification_outbox"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("notification_outbox"."status" = 'failed') = ("notification_outbox"."terminal_failed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("notification_outbox"."status" = 'skipped') = ("notification_outbox"."skipped_at" IS NOT NULL)
